image.title: Madonna di Crevole
image.creator: Duccio di Buoninsegna
image.attribution: Duccio di Buoninsegna, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
image.why: A Sienese Madonna painted when Dante was a young man

summary.en: Mother of Jesus. In medieval Catholic devotion she was honoured as Mother of God and Queen of Heaven and was the first of all intercessors, the one through whom prayers reached God; Marian hymns and prayers such as the Ave Maria were part of every Christian's daily devotion in Dante's time.

en: Honoured in the Middle Ages as Queen of Heaven (Regina Coeli)
